topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture objectives, the multistep model of tumor progression, and the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulated growth and proliferation signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how mutations in key signaling cascades such as Wnt/beta-catenin, receptor tyrosine kinases, and TGF-beta drive autonomous cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation blocks in malignancy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how impaired cellular differentiation contributes to tumor progression in hematological cancers and intestinal carcinomas.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the molecular mechanisms and regulatory balance between pro- and anti-apoptotic factors that allow cancer cells to evade programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, telomere maintenance, and senescent stress signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tumor cells achieve replicative immortality by overcoming telomere shortening and bypassing normal p53-mediated senescence stress responses.

topics.label: Cancer metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the metabolic rewiring of cancer cells toward aerobic glycolysis and the role of metabolic enzyme mutations and oncometabolites in altering gene regulation.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the necessity of new blood vessel recruitment for tumor growth and the regulatory balance controlling the angiogenic switch.

topics.label: Mechanisms, dissemination, and genetics of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the multi-step metastatic cascade, methods for monitoring circulating tumor cells, microenvironmental compatibility, and the clonal genetics underlying metastatic disease.

topics.label: Conclusion and lecture summary
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides concluding remarks on the integration of cancer hallmarks and closes the lecture.
